Topic 3.5: Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives to overcome daily challenges water

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives to overcome daily challenges water
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives to overcome daily challenges water. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.
2. Explain Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should read Mark 5:35-43 1.
4. Show that you can: appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives to overcome daily challenges water
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Mark 5:35-43 1.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives to overcome daily challenges water

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
